discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators (the quantum spin Hall effect)
rationale: Topological insulators are a mature, foundational area of condensed matter physics that the committee has signaled interest in (2016 topological phases prize). Kane and Mele predicted the quantum spin Hall effect (Z2 topological insulator) in 2005, and Molenkamp's group confirmed it in HgTe quantum wells in 2007. The field has opened a large research area, and the laureates have collected major prizes such as the Breakthrough Prize and the Dirac Medal. Shoucheng Zhang co-predicted the HgTe realization but died in 2018 and cannot be awarded.
